name: Suzuki SV650 (1999-2002)
engine: 645 cc liquid-cooled DOHC 90-degree V-twin, two carbs
intro: A great all-round twin. The regulator/rectifier is the known weak spot on the early ones.

add.title: Test the regulator/rectifier
add.instructions: Check battery voltage at idle and at 5,000 rpm. If it is low or above about 15 volts, test the stator and replace the regulator/rectifier.
add.reason: Early SV650s are known for regulator/rectifier failures that can kill the battery or the stator.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Charging
known.what: 1999-2002 models are prone to regulator/rectifier failure, which can kill the battery or damage the stator.
